items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Julio Cuevas - that he was with Cascarita - a great singer, Cuban singer, was singing with him and he was arranging for Cascarita

ctx.x: Do you remember how that came about?

Well, Miguelito Valdes was free-lancing so this company, Verne, owned by Cuevas, he approached us. Miguelito, Marcelino Guerra, Trio San Juan, myself,/and he wanted to make a 'catalog so that particular time we recorded with and a few other bands
